script.title: Piplup — A Little Wave
script.description: A big round Piplup with bright eyes, a pointed yellow beak, two white chest buttons, webbed feet and one flipper lifted in greeting. A sculpted blue crown, white cheek lobes and a tiny fanned tail finish every view.
